record.title: Prepare exact ordinary-option and capability deployment contracts
record.intent: Translate accepted guest results into minimal physical commands and rollback requirements.
requirements: Inspect existing guest and physical evidence; identify ordinary installer entry point, exact candidate provenance, baseline and reboot verification commands without running them on the instrument.

Determine the smallest persistent D-capability deployment path, Android package/signature and native loading constraints, preserved originals and rollback checks; do not assume the guest component host proves APK deployment.
Keep private identities and license material outside source; distinguish documented interfaces from implementation-derived procedures.
acceptance: The next physical changes and their rollback/verification gates are concrete.
